comment: The `replaces` of the layers between two plateaus are composed (wave 017, run 0125, issue #89). ComposeReplacesCasesTest.java (command line) and compose-replaces.test.js (editor) read this file: add a case here and both run it, so that the two tools give the same table. `files`: a path from the folder of the workspace -> the text of the file (the manifests are below `manifests/`; the plateaus are layers: `p1` overrides `baseline`, `p2` overrides `p1`, and so on; a `REMOVE` patch takes out the element the layer replaced). `comparisons`: `diff --plateau <plateau> --against <against>` in the command line, the plateau drawn and compared with the other one in the editor (the later plateau is the one drawn, the other the base: an ancestor or a sibling); `rows`: the rows of the table that are elements, as `layer|reference|change|replaces` (the replaces are the composed ones, joined with a comma, sorted); `warnings`: the sentences about a `replaces` that was ignored. A comparison with the plateau a plateau overrides (one step) is as it was before the composition: it is in the cases to show it.

cases.what: a move made in two steps is a move from the first plateau; each step alone is the move it was

files.manifests/p1/plateau.yaml:
header:
  kind: "archicode.morin.io/plateau"
  version: "1"
content:
  id: "p1"
  patches:
    - operator: REMOVE
      target: "a"
files.manifests/p2/plateau.yaml:
header:
  kind: "archicode.morin.io/plateau"
  version: "1"
content:
  id: "p2"
  override: "p1"
  patches:
    - operator: REMOVE
      target: "b"
files.manifests/base/a.yaml:
header:
  kind: "archicode.morin.io/system"
  version: "1"
content:
  id: "a"
  name: "A"
files.manifests/p1/b.yaml:
header:
  kind: "archicode.morin.io/system"
  version: "1"
  plateau: p1
content:
  id: "b"
  name: "B"
  replaces: ["a"]
files.manifests/p2/c.yaml:
header:
  kind: "archicode.morin.io/system"
  version: "1"
  plateau: p2
content:
  id: "c"
  name: "C"
  replaces: ["b"]
